about_the_game:
When Ford means fast: discover 3 of the most appreciated cars made by the historic American manufacturer. Add them to your collection today!

This pack includes:
- Ford Mustang Shelby® GT500® (2020)
- Ford Mustang GT Convertible (2024)
- Ford Focus RS (2016)

In-game content. Requires The Crew Motorfest (base game, sold separately) to access. Vehicles included in this bundle are available in The Crew Motorfest and some may also be available in The Crew 2. Please check your in-game inventory before purchase. No compensation will be granted in case of duplicate if you already own some or all of the vehicles included or if you import your vehicle collection from The Crew 2.
